sections.text: The NRF grant conditions remain in force as issued on 19 January 2027. The monthly reporting requirement remains due by the 10th working day, and two consecutive late or incomplete reports may suspend the next tranche. The March contractor report notes that the grant monthly report was issued on the 4th working day, so it appears to have met the monthly timing requirement on that occasion.
